Welcome to Cyrus Says!
What could the proposed animal-testing rules mean for animal welfare in India?
Maneka Gandhi joins Cyrus Broacha to explain her concerns about the draft rules, the safeguards she believes are at risk, and alternatives to animal testing. She also reflects on her work against animal cruelty and explains how citizens can raise their objections.
Watch first on Amazon Music!
